item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We know what is at stake: if commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. We refuse to sacrifice irreplaceable life for extraction. We demand a stop before the damage starts.

2. We cannot rebuild a deep-ocean ecosystem once mining destroys it. We stand against commercial deep-sea mining because permanent destruction is not an acceptable price for minerals.

3. We believe the deep ocean deserves protection, not exploitation. Commercial deep-sea mining will permanently destroy its ecosystems. We are calling for a future that leaves these habitats intact—not an industry that tears them apart.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We will not accept the permanent destruction of deep-ocean ecosystems as the price of commercial mining. If this industry begins operating, it will destroy habitats that cannot be replaced and erase life we are still discovering. We reject the idea that the ocean floor is simply a storehouse of minerals waiting to be extracted. We see a living world worth defending, and we are determined to protect it before the damage begins. Our demand is clear: stop commercial deep-sea mining before it starts. Together, we can insist that the pursuit of resources never becomes an excuse to sacrifice irreplaceable ecosystems. We must act now.
